mechanism: Galantamine is metabolized via CYP2D6 and CYP3A4; valproate may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism, potentially increasing galantamine levels, while both drugs can cause additive CNS effects and gastrointestinal toxicity.
action: Monitor for increased galantamine adverse effects (nausea, bradycardia, syncope) and consider dose adjustment if needed; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended due to additive cardiac effects.
